context: Define one recursive public-egress policy that classifies values as credentials, identifying local paths, allowed non-identifying paths, URLs, or ordinary strings. Reuse the existing anonymization specifications and submission validator, then assert the same policy against exporter output, submitted bundles and companions, corpus inventory inputs, and the exact Explorer publication output. Reject rather than silently publish any residual user-home, private-volume, or Windows-profile path. Keep credential redaction distinct from path hashing.
description: Release-readiness review evidence at 17c0c098a found 650 machine-local absolute-path values across 183 of 207 curated bundles, including working directories and driver-runtime executables. No email, credential-key, or URL-query secret was reproduced, but the path values conflict with the public anonymization contract and are copied into the Explorer download surface. This item prevents recurrence at the producer, submission validator, and Explorer publication boundary. It does not rewrite the existing corpus; that is owned by the dependent backfill item.

anti_patterns.dont: patch only driver_runtime_python_executable or a short field-name allowlist
anti_patterns.instead: combine explicit semantic keys with recursive value classification at each public egress boundary
anti_patterns.why: the reproduced leak also occurs under working_dir, raw_config, database_path, and nested metadata and would recur under a new key

anti_patterns.dont: rewrite curated bundles in this item
anti_patterns.why: prevention must land and be tested before a content migration changes hashes and references

anti_patterns.dont: treat hashed credentials as safe public output
anti_patterns.instead: redact secrets and hash only approved identity/path values
anti_patterns.why: credential material must be removed, not converted into a stable correlation identifier

anti_patterns.dont: weaken submission hash, traversal, symlink, or trust checks while inserting the privacy scan
anti_patterns.instead: run the new check after safe parsing and before acceptance without reordering existing security checks
anti_patterns.why: privacy validation is additive to the existing hostile-input boundary

preserves.behavior: Existing hash, symlink, traversal, trust-label, and vendor-governance validation remains at least as strict.
Local-only anonymize=False consumers retain their documented non-secret diagnostic metadata; the fail-closed rule applies at public egress boundaries.
Secret-looking values remain redacted rather than reversibly hashed.
The public contract is recursive across bundle, manifest, and companion objects and cannot be bypassed by renaming a field.
URLs, SQL text, benchmark identifiers, and legitimate relative source references are not corrupted by a blanket slash regex.

prior_art.concept: The publication pipeline is the last chance to reject legacy curated data before it becomes directly downloadable.
Existing recursive public anonymization and path-key classifier are the single policy seam; extend rather than parallelize them.
Existing hostile-input and manifest validation is the public admission boundary; add the path-privacy decision there.

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c 'import json,re; from pathlib import Path; bad=[str(p) for p in Path("results-data/bundles").glob("*.json") if re.search(r"(?:/Users/|/home/|[A-Za-z]:\\Users\\)", json.dumps(json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))))]; assert not bad, f"{len(bad)} bundles contain private home paths"'
verifications.description: The committed curated corpus contains no user-home path
verifications.expected: Fails on the unfixed corpus; exits 0 only after no curated bundle contains a private home path.

verifications.description: Public anonymization and submission security regressions pass
verifications.expected: All focused tests pass after the privacy policy is enforced.

verifications.description: Explorer publication tests reject a residual path in copied output
verifications.expected: Pipeline tests include and pass a negative fixture whose unexpected nested absolute path is rejected without echoing its value.
